blocker.stillUnknown: The failing harness imports a fresh fixture each run; the comparison reused one. That is the leading remaining difference and is NOT established: a direct probe that also imported a fresh project reached ready in about 5s. So neither instrumentation alone nor fresh import alone reproduces it. The next experiment should vary fixture freshness while holding instrumentation constant — the inverse of the one just run.
blocker.instrumentationRuledOut: A controlled paired comparison (managed-studio-startup-compare.mjs) ran six instrumentation profiles in both orders against a reused fixture. All twelve trials mounted in 788-1878ms, including both fully instrumented controls. Its own verdict was 'baseline-failure-not-reproduced', exit 2 — inconclusive by design, because a passing variant means nothing when the control also passes. What it does establish is that network diagnostics, the console observer, the response summary, checkpoint writes and animation-frame polling are not the cause.
